title: Dark Conniption Fighter
description: Dark Conniption Fighter — The Townstons wiki
html:
The most common fighter build for PvP that's out there will be a "DC" (dark conniption) fighter.

They're hard hitting and quick.

Here are the skills mostly set up for fighter using "DC"

Left click-Holy Roller is a must have for a fighter in PvP especially for those fast running foes. It prevents them from running by unleashing a savage rush towards your opponent trapping them for a short amount of time
Right click-MFB My Flaming Buddy one of the most effective PvP skills out there the key for a fighter is to spam mfb, more mfb means faster dying opponent.
Hot key #1 Fear of Gosh is much like Fears Shot, the only difference is you have to get in their face to apply it.
hot key#2-fire,shadow,divine,poison,or ice resistance is a key to win mix them up depending on the type of person you're fighting against. If your opponent has a mixture of skills apply them to skills you think aren't needed
hot key#3-Acidic Blight very,very,very useful skill for a fighter. If it is effective your hits will have a much higher accuracy to strike your opponent.
Hot key#4-DC Dark Conniption itself. it applies shadow damage to your weape\on and increases your attack speed (attack speed may very depending on the level of your DC) it may sound all nice but there are some skeletons hidden in the closet, sadly it will decrease your defence rating making you more vulnerable to getting hit.
Hot key#5-Heal Self, Not Other Just what it says its basically a "1 shot health potion" but be careful while using it,it can easily be canceled out if you take damage.
hot key#6-Way of the Roomust have for a fighter in PvP only change is faster attack speed and rating
hot key#7-Average BMI (10% more health...YEA!!!!)
hot key#8-Gym Freak (50% more hp --- WITH A CAMEL!!!)

Well, that's the most basic "DC" fighter build. Mix it up a bit and see were that gets ya ;) haha remember if u have any quistions you're more then welcome to ask me if you see me on haha. gl pvping and go r*pe some peeps!
